distractors.hard_rule: Author distractors with each question family from item-specific misconceptions. Every wrong choice must be plausible for that exact stem; conceptually equivalent correct choices are prohibited.
examples_to_reject: balanced + net force 0 N when both answer the stem
unrelated observation/inference/balanced filler on symbol or calculation items
distractors.repeated_wrong_choice_threshold_is_hard_: Hard for substantive repeated textual choices; short numeric/unit choices are surfaced for review because legitimate recurrence is possible.

security.hard_rule: Formative-secure/secure items must be semantically independent from prior instructional items.

representations.hard_review: Representation-heavy sections require actual student-facing visual/table use or an explicit rationale after Framework visual/table inspection.
representations.unused_packaged_figure_rule: Normally reference each packaged figure in at least one canonical item or remove it.
representations.hard_rule: When the I-can/evidence job explicitly requires interpreting, constructing, critiquing, comparing, or using a diagram, graph, table, vector, force model, ray, field, or circuit, the student must receive that ACTUAL representation. A prose description of a diagram is not equivalent evidence.
representations.answer_neutrality_not_avoidance: NEVER SHOW THE ANSWER IN THE STUDENT IMAGE does NOT mean avoid images. Build/crop/redraw an answer-neutral representation when the evidence job requires one.

counts.owned_by: profiles/bank_course_profile.json after universal Base inventory mechanics are resolved
counts.rule: Use the Physics-resolved inventory in profiles/bank_course_profile.json. Counts are destination containers, not I-can allocation targets. Physics Notes = 4 Example/YTI pairs = 8 canonical Notes items per section.

teacher_keys.bank_html_default: Omit visible Teacher Key blocks for routine instructional items; keep required canonical answer/evidence data in machine files.

progressive_authoring.hard_rule: Verify correctness/alignment while authoring, but do not launch late anti-clone or generator-diversification passes. Repair actual flagged defects only.
progressive_authoring.late_patch_rule: Repair flagged family/section and revalidate; do not apply a unit-wide semantic text patch without family-level revalidation.

duplicates.hard_rule: Exact literal student-prompt duplication across canonical items is prohibited by default. Reuse the learning FAMILY, not the finished question. A non-secure instructional exact repeat is allowed only when the item records a specific intentional_exact_repeat_reason explaining the pedagogical need; secure/Summative exact repeats are never exempt.
duplicates.practice_rule: Practice may repeat a conceptual/procedural family, but change meaningful evidence features such as values, context, representation, givens/unknown, misconception, or reasoning action. Copy-pasting the same finished prompt to fill inventory is a defect.
duplicates.numeric_shell_review: Number-only or unit-only rewrites of the same prompt skeleton are surfaced for review when they cluster heavily; useful family repetition remains allowed.
duplicates.secure_rule: No exact secure prompt may appear twice within a form, across V1-V6, or in exposed instructional inventory. Secure forms require new evidence stimuli, not cloned instructional shells.
duplicates.semantic_clone_rule: Meaningful variation must change the evidence, not merely nouns, numbers, units, or choice order. A repeated prompt architecture with object/number substitutions is a semantic clone even when literal text is unique.
duplicates.secure_semantic_clone_rule: Secure/Summative items may share an I-can or broad family, but number swaps, object swaps, sentence-order changes, or reordered answer choices alone do not establish independence. Repeated secure semantic shells are hard failures.
duplicates.instructional_semantic_clone_rule: A small amount of family repetition is useful; heavy repetition of the same number/object-normalized shell is a defect. Do not manufacture variation by inserting irrelevant measurements.

practice_prompt_hygiene.hard_rule: Repeated families appear as ordinary clean questions. No second-pass/another-version generator labels and no one generic explanation/checking/reasonableness suffix across most/all Practice items.

map_first_repetition.hard_rule: Use the full-scope map before authoring to distinguish purposeful Physics repetition from template-driven cloning. This does not replace the existing ban on late anti-clone/diversification passes.

i_can_first.hard_rule: The exact I-can is the atomic evidence address. Section inventory compliance cannot compensate for an I-can coverage gap.
i_can_first.coverage_validation: Finalizer must hard-fail missing Notes pair, Practice-set coverage, CYU, combined Warm-Up coverage, parallel Exit coverage, or per-form Summative coverage for any exact I-can.
i_can_first.distribution: Do not automatically split a 24-question practice container 8/8/8 across three I-cans. Determine each I-can's evidence need first, then reconcile to 24. Equal counts are allowed only when the evidence plan genuinely supports them; mechanical symmetry is a review flag.

figure_answer_neutrality.hard_rule: NEVER SHOW THE ANSWER IN THE STUDENT IMAGE.
figure_answer_neutrality.qa: Every Physics figure reference must carry explicit answer-neutrality verification metadata; answer-sensitive tasks also certify answer_bearing_elements_removed=true.

physical_plausibility.hard_rule: Every Physics context must be physically coherent and grammatically natural before release. Do not combine mutually exclusive states (for example moving at steady speed and at rest) or Mad-Lib nouns that do not fit the motion/setup.
physical_plausibility.irrelevant_data_rule: Every numerical value, unit, observation, and contextual detail must affect the model, inference, comparison, or calculation. Do not add an unused mass/time/distance merely to make a cloned prompt look different.
physical_plausibility.high_confidence_contradictions: High-confidence physical contradictions are hard failures; grammar/context oddities are surfaced for review.

machine_handoff.hard_rule: Canonical Bank JSON must satisfy the literal downstream schema. Do not substitute aliases such as security for security_level or omit per-item DOK/evidence-point metadata.
machine_handoff.finalizer_rule: The finalizer validates required literal fields on every canonical item and the structured figures/tables contract.

source_provenance.hard_rule: source_basis records what actually informed the individual item. Do not stamp the same framework/PM/question-family boilerplate onto the entire Bank.
source_provenance.review_rule: A single identical source_basis dominating the unit is a provenance-quality warning unless it is a concise truthful default such as Assessment Plan only; source_metadata should identify specific source packets/pages/figures when actually consulted.

audit_status.hard_rule: Every canonical item carries audit_status with one exact value: NEEDS AUDIT, KEEP, CLEAN, or REBUILD. A fresh Bank initializes every item to NEEDS AUDIT. Audit status is review metadata and never appears inside student-prompt content.

meaning.NEEDS AUDIT: Initial build state; question has not yet received a content-audit disposition.
meaning.REBUILD: Hard content, representation, or context problem.

audit_status.reset_rule: If student content, choices, answer/key, evidence job, or representation is materially changed later, reset the item to NEEDS AUDIT until the revision is audited again.

wtc_frq.hard_rule: Every WTC must be a true connected multi-part FRQ built around one shared stimulus, normally 3-5 labeled parts. WTC is for FRQ decomposition/navigation practice and is not a current-Unit coverage device.
wtc_frq.cross_unit: Content may come from any Physics Unit. Preserve the exact source content i_can_id/i_can statement, set coverage_role=wtc_frq_practice, and exclude WTC from current-Unit I-can coverage calculations.
wtc_frq.unfamiliar_content: If the physics is not yet taught, parts must remain accessible as unpacking, representation, relationship selection, qualitative prediction, or planning rather than requiring mastery of the untaught procedure.
wtc_frq.representation: When the FRQ depends on a graph/table/diagram/model/data set, provide the actual representation.
wtc_frq.anti_copy: Use released/workbook FRQs only as structural exemplars. Do not copy their text, data, figures, or solution sequence.

question_design_map.hard_rule: Pre-authoring question design map required. Every canonical item links to a planned slot. Variety is selected by I-can fit, not global quotas.
question_design_map.semantic_family_rule: question_family_id must describe the evidence family and may not use version/question-number tokens to manufacture uniqueness.
question_design_map.exit_security_rule: Exit Ticket destination is formative-secure for Physics semantic clone QA regardless of security_level string.
question_design_map.inline_svg_rule: Inline SVG must carry structured answer-neutrality QA metadata through figures[].
